note: These are design-preview tokens decided from official product photographs, expressed in the official 22-card language (one saturated solid field per card; Style B adds a darker same-hue ground oval). They are NOT official finished M5Stack product-card colors.

official_22_card_rule.finding: Each official card uses its own full-bleed saturated solid background. 22 cards yield 20 unique backgrounds; only 01_S3/12_STICKV share #009ee0 and 16_BALA/20_CORE2 share #e30016. Style groups 01-09 and 10-22 are NOT locked to one blue. Official docs already state 配色是高饱和纯色满版底，每张一色.

style_a_visible_tokens_on_01_S3_template.note: No ground oval. Do not retint the unused gradient stop that also contains #009ee0.

StampFly.sku_note: Family name StampFly; v1.1 also exists. Filename uses StampFly.

style_a.evidence: Motor-hub / motor-can orange sampled from official top-down photo /workspace/stampfly-preview/official/orig/5.webp; tight orange median RGB (243, 62, 26) = #f33e1a.
style_a.why: Orange hubs are the signature accent of StampFly (also visible on side views and the colorful flight-controller photos). Saturated solid matches official card language. White typography stays readable.

style_b.evidence: Same hub-orange signature. Style B mascot is white rotors + black body + orange hubs; a light duct-white field would wash out the rotors, so the same signature orange is used. Shadow is 0.82 darken of the field (#c73215), following the official CORE/STICKC pairing pattern (darker same-hue oval), not a second invented hue.
style_b.why: This product's dominant characteristic color is the hub orange; black frame would hide the mascot body. Two styles share the signature hue but remain visually distinct because the char language differs.

style_a.evidence: PWR-CAN red connector median RGB (210, 51, 49) = #d23331 sampled from official operation-front K141_02 (int16-safe threshold).
style_a.why: The red XT-style power/CAN connector and the red RELAY markings are the most distinctive color blocks on the white industrial housing.

style_b.evidence: PWR-485 blue connector median RGB (8, 132, 204) = #0884cc from the same official front. This is the product's connector blue, not the old template lock colors #009ee0 / #0079b4.
style_b.why: StamPLC pairs a red CAN connector with a blue 485 connector on the front panel; using those two signature colors for A/B keeps the set rich and product-true. Shadow #066ca7 is 0.82 darken.

style_a.evidence: Red MX battery connector median RGB (180, 67, 67) = #b44343 sampled from official side photo C158_CoreMatrix_main_pictures_14.jpg (and visible in the 3/4 view 06, which was not used as a generation main reference).
style_a.why: The shell is black and the face is a cool-white 16x16 LED matrix; the red battery connector is the only saturated body accent. Existing approved Style A char is kept; only the card field changes. Distinct from StamPLC's brighter connector red #d23331.

style_b.evidence: Official front LED bloom / cool halo median RGB (165, 173, 189). That gray-blue was saturation-boosted (HLS hue kept ~0.611, L=0.55, S=0.42) to a solid #5c7cbc so it matches official high-saturation card language while staying derived from the LED glow, not from the old #0079b4/#009ee0 locks. Shadow #4b659a is 0.82 darken.
style_b.why: A black field would swallow the black mascot. The cool LED atmosphere gives Style B a light-wall identity and contrast for the white LED dots and eye rings. The approved v3 char is not regenerated.

style_a.evidence: Orange power-switch rocker median RGB (200, 55, 17) = #c83711 sampled from official H050 front C154-CardputerZero-main-pictures_06.png, top-right POWER SWITCH. Key-legend orange on the same face is a related but lighter (234, 102, 53).
style_a.why: The orange rocker and orange function-key legends are the signature accents on the light-gray shell. This orange is warmer/darker than StampFly hub orange #f33e1a, so the two products stay distinguishable.

style_b.evidence: Purple Shift-key legend median RGB (171, 65, 157) = #ab419d from the same official H050 front.
style_b.why: Shift purple is a unique keyboard-legend color on CardputerZero and gives Style B a second product-true hue (not merely a light/dark of the orange). Shadow #8c3580 is 0.82 darken. White type remains readable.
